thread:
maya: acme POC reporting 401s + one 403 on stream after onboarding. they pasted a token into env.

own: can you paste error text?

maya: dev sent this: \
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_user_444" -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate\

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"token_org_mismatch: token bound to 'dev-team' (org=dev-labs)","code":401}

maya: and for stream: \
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"required scope 'inference:stream' not present","code": 403}

li: yep two causes: wrong-org token + missing stream scope. ops-bot shows token_errors spike at 16:02.

ops-bot: metrics: acme-poc - token_errors: 26, avg_rps: 6.7 (10m).

own: remediation: create org-scoped token with scopes inference:invoke[,inference:stream] and bind project if they use project headers. use rdwctl for scripted creation.

maya: customer asks if switching to org-managed tokens affects pricing/quota.

li: short answer: no. Pricing/quotas follow the billing org. token type doesn't change pricing.

maya: security wants a one-sentence audit blurb to send.

li: "Redwood records token lifecycle events (create, revoke, rotate), creator metadata, scopes, bindings (org/project), and last-used timestamps; audit logs are available in the console and via the tokens API."

maya: customer rotated to an org token with stream scope and confirmed calls succeed. I'll close the POC ticket and update CRM.

own: i'll follow up with repro snippet and rdwctl example.

ops-bot: monitoring: token_errors cleared for acme-poc (last 10m).

maya: thanks team, closing swarm.
